title: Bird Feeder Visitor Species Log
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdfeeder:detection confidence>0.7
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits, dc(species) as species_seen by _time
| stats sum(visits) as total_visits, max(species_seen) as daily_species by species
| sort - total_visits
description: Turns your smart bird feeder's camera detections into a running log of which species visited and how often, a delightful backyard biodiversity record.
value: A species log makes a hobby measurable and rewarding, and over time reveals seasonal migration and the effect of different seed.
implementation: Forward bird-camera detections with species and confidence; schedule daily and build a species leaderboard.
visualization: Bar chart of visits by species over time.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a fun log of which birds visited your feeder and how often, like a backyard nature diary.
